design_decisions.title: kb_grounding is a SUPPRESS contract (the S-BS-7 generalization), NOT a structural floor
design_decisions.rationale: The driver says register kb_grounding in _CONTRACT_EXECUTORS 'following the PresenceCheck pattern' — i.e. a contract that DISPROVES a confident-wrong flag. KbGrounding subclasses VerificationContract with check(finding, case) -> Verdict: it grounds the council's claim in the KB (the policy the council said was violated actually permits the disclosure / the cited code is real & on-point) and returns disproved=True only on a positive, score-clearing, corroborated KB hit. This is the suppress direction (generalizing PresenceCheck from the transcript to the KB), distinct from the _FLOOR_CONTRACT_TYPES inject-a-BLOCK direction.

design_decisions.title: http_client threaded into suppress contracts via _build_contract + a sibling _HTTP_CONTRACT_TYPES set
design_decisions.rationale: kb_grounding composes over live :8002, so it needs the injected http_client that ground() already threads for the floor. PresenceCheck is pure-stdlib and takes only the decl. Solution: _build_contract(decl, *, http_client) passes the client ONLY for contract_types in _HTTP_CONTRACT_TYPES={'kb_grounding'}; ground()'s suppress-contract construction now passes http_client. Offline tests inject a fake client; default-deps ground() (no kb_grounding declared) is byte-identical to before and pulls no httpx.

design_decisions.title: Tri-state mapping: present-grounding clears (True) or is inconclusive (None); expect='absent' disproves on a hit (False)
design_decisions.rationale: Default contracts (expect='present') return True when the KB grounds the claim (flag MAY clear) and None otherwise — KB silence/below-threshold/predicate-unmet/endpoint-error never clears a flag (CLAUDE.md core invariant: never clear by silence). The SME can pin expect='absent' for a disprove-by-retrieval claim, where a clearing hit returns False (VIOLATION). No default path returns False, so the suppress executor only ever suppresses on a positive ground.

design_decisions.title: BFF endpoint mirrors the backend path shape (GET /v1/kb/{namespace}/search), additive, lazy-imported
design_decisions.rationale: So the shell can hit the BFF identically to :8002. The handler builds a Claim from q, runs KbRagTool, and returns the grounding verdict + manifest. KbRagTool/VerificationSpec are imported lazily INSIDE the handler (httpx stays in the [bff] extra; module import is unchanged). Two new overridable deps (get_kb_service, get_kb_http_client) keep tests hermetic. NO existing endpoint signature touched.
